Airframe - Streamlined hull. Its meant to fly from a 1G world, to space. It has modules for Reusable Boosters.  A prettier version of the Lockheed X-33. 
This can work vertically, if needed.
New Hull, Streamlined.  Hides near atmospheric worlds and gas giants for ambush and recon.  looks like LOGH Imperial designs.  You can use the 300DT Hull but with more lift body.
